transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been struggling with eating really huge amounts of food. Once I start, I feel like I have a complete loss of control and just can't stop myself.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever do things to try to prevent weight gain, such as making yourself throw up, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things to try and prevent weight gain. I've never made myself throw up, used laxatives, or forced myself to fast or over-exercise after eating.
Could you tell me what your current height and weight are, and whether you have recently lost a significant amount of weight?

I'm not actually sure of my exact height and weight right now, as I haven't stepped on a scale in a while. I haven't really been keeping track, but I don't think I've had any significant weight loss recently.
How often do these episodes of eating large amounts of food occur, and how long has this been happening?
This has been going on for about a year and a half now. On average, these eating episodes happen at least once a week, and it's been at that frequency for at least the last three months.
During these episodes, do you experience things like eating much faster than normal, eating until you feel uncomfortably full, or feeling very guilty or disgusted with yourself afterward?

Yes, I definitely notice that I eat much faster than normal during these episodes, almost like I can't get the food down quick enough. As for eating until I'm uncomfortably full or feeling guilty afterward, I'm not entirely sure because I haven't paid as much attention to those aspects.
Do you often find yourself eating these large amounts of food even when you aren't physically hungry, or eating alone because you feel embarrassed by how much you are consuming?

I'm not quite sure about eating when I'm not hungry, but I definitely eat alone because of how embarrassed I am. I feel so ashamed of the huge amounts of food I'm consuming that I make sure no one else is around to see it.
Do these episodes of eating cause you significant distress, or do they make you feel very upset and affect your daily life?
I haven't really thought about it, so I'm not quite sure how to describe how it impacts my daily life. I do know that I feel incredibly embarrassed and upset about the eating itself, though.
After these eating episodes, do you ever find yourself feeling disgusted with yourself or deeply depressed about what happened?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it in that way, so I can't say for sure if I feel disgusted or depressed afterward.
When you have these eating episodes, do you find yourself continuing to eat until you feel physically uncomfortable or painfully full?
No, I don't typically eat until I feel physically uncomfortable or painfully full. I haven't really noticed that happening during my eating episodes.
When you start these eating episodes, do you usually feel physically hungry beforehand, or do you find yourself eating even when you don't feel hungry at all?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really paid close attention to whether I feel physically hungry or not before these episodes start.
